# Uniswap Documentation

Integrate swaps, manage liquidity, launch tokens and more with AI-friendly DeFi tooling.

[Quick start](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/get-started/quickstart) [Agent skills](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/uniswap-ai/skills)

Quick Start

Agent skills

```
npx skills add uniswap/uniswap-ai --skill swap-integration
```

### For app builders

Add swapping features to any app

[Display token prices](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/ecosystem/subgraphs/overview)

[Manage positions](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/liquidity/liquidity-provisioning-api/getting-started)

### For market makers

Advanced LP tooling

[Create a pool](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/protocols/v4/guides/create-pool)

[Create a hook](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/protocols/v4/guides/hooks/getting-started)

[Launch a token](https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/liquidity/liquidity-launchpad/overview)
